newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: STAD R'DAM SEES EPS DILUTION WITH LOAN REPAYMENTS.
newsitem.headline: STAD R'DAM SEES EPS DILUTION WITH LOAN REPAYMENTS.

text.p: Insurer Stad Rotterdam said on Wednesday it expected earnings per share (EPS) to dilute by about two percent in 1997 and by another four percent by the end of 2001 with the excercise of two loans.
Stad Rotterdam said it had paid back its "Lions" loan in shares on January 15, 1997.
"Earnings per share will be diluted by two percent with this," Stad Rotterdam chairman Carlo de Swart said.
He added EPS would be diluted by another four percent before the end 2001 as result of the repayment, also in the form of shares, of a convertible loan of 150 million guilders.
The convertible loan can be exercised before the expiry date at the end of 2001.
